program.name: Bell Hips & Core
program.subject: Kettlebell only
program.blurb: Hips and core with one bell: swing and sumo circuits, then windmills, halos and carries.
program.about: The kettlebell at its best: hips and core. One day is a circuit of swings, sumo deadlifts, sumo pulses and goblet squats; the other is windmills, halos, around-the-body passes and suitcase carries. Strong hips and a strong middle carry over to everything. Abs finish every session. Level II adds reps and Level III asks for a heavier bell.
program.split: Swing & sumo circuit / core & carry circuit
